pull.title: rpc: reject AssumeUTXO rollback without tip data
pull.body:
**Problem:** Loading a UTXO snapshot on a pruned node can leave the active tip without block or undo data. Attempting a rollback with `dumptxoutset` then triggers an assertion and terminates the node.

**Fix:** Reuse `GetPruneHeight` to reject rollback with the existing pruning error when the required data is unavailable.

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36503 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36503#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. | Type | Reviewers | | ---- | --------- | | Concept ACK | [musaHaruna](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36503#pullrequestreview-5492606225) | | Stale ACK | [cyb3ralbert](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36503#pullrequestreview-5870781677) | If your review is incorrectly listed, please copy-paste <!--meta-tag:bot-skip--> into the comment that the bot should ignore. ### Conflicts Reviewers, this pull request conflicts with the following ones: * [#36778](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36778) (AssumeUTXO: replace `loadtxoutset` RPC with a startup arg by l0rinc) * [#36702](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36702) (validation: don't treat snapshot block as linked on startup by shuv-amp) If you consider this pull request important, please also help to review the conflicting pull requests. Ideally, start with the one that should be merged first.

Concept ACK. The fix looks straightforward and contained: `GetPruneHeight` handles missing data at the tip before calling `GetFirstBlock`, allowing the RPC to return an error instead of hitting the assertion.

I have a few questions about the surrounding behavior. 

- Should the early availability check also cover non-pruned nodes? They can load a snapshot without having the historical block or undo data. I understand that the code limits the early check to pruning mode, and non-pruned nodes can fail later during rollback. Could checking availability earlier avoid copying the UTXO set before discovering that rollback is impossible? Registering `TemporaryPruneLock` could still remain conditional on `IsPruneMode()`.

- Would a more general error message describe these cases better? Specifically, changing:
`Could not roll back to requested height since necessary block data is already pruned.`
to:
`Could not roll back to requested height because required block or undo data is unavailable.`
After loading a UTXO snapshot, the node may lack historical block or undo data because it has not obtained or generated it yet, not because pruning deleted it. Keeping the existing wording for this focused fix seems reasonable, though.

- Could the boundary eventually compare the highest missing-data height against the target using `>` instead of `>=`? The loop in `CreateRolledBackUTXOSnapshot` uses: `while (block_index->nHeight > target->nHeight)`
For example, exporting state 299 from tip 301 disconnects blocks 301 and 300, so it does not need undo for block 299. If `GetPruneHeight` returns 299, the current `299 >= 299` check rejects that request, whereas `299 > 299` would allow it. Am I missing another requirement for the target’s data?
In a locally modified version using `>` and applying the early availability check to both pruned and non-pruned nodes, the added boundary tests passed. Exporting state 299 succeeded and matched the original snapshot’s UTXO hash, while exporting state 298 still failed.

Tested ACK 3cb70c28f5e97bd42f45b4a917e21fbd1452f4a3

Tested on Linux aarch64, GCC 14.2.0, Release build:

- `feature_assumeutxo.py` and `rpc_dumptxoutset.py` passed.
- 874 unit tests passed (one with warnings).

Cases checked:

- Missing snapshot tip and missing undo data: both abort in `GetFirstBlock()` on the base commit and return the expected RPC errors with the fix.
- Pruned-node export at height 398 (tip 399) matches the full node's UTXO hash.
- Historical-gap and target-equality checks pass on the base.

To reproduce the functional tests:
```
python3 build/test/functional/test_runner.py feature_assumeutxo.py rpc_dumptxoutset.py
```

rpc: check block and undo data above rollback target

Rollback disconnects only blocks above the requested height. Check those blocks for missing body or undo data before copying the UTXO set on pruned nodes and snapshot chainstates.
Report unavailable data because snapshot history may not yet have been downloaded.

Suggested in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36503#pullrequestreview-5492606225
